name: Zodiac Series - Tiger Postcards (set of 2 Designs) (PCTGRPCD)
page_name: Zodiac Series - Tiger Postcards (set of 2 Designs) (PCTGRPCD)
description:
The Chinese calendar is based on five cycles of 12 years each, with each cycle tempered by one of the five Chinese elements – Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth. Each year features one of the 12 animal signs, and the year of 2022 is that of the Water Tiger.


The year 2022 marks the reign of the Tiger and the third animal in the Zodiac series on the Chinese calendar. This independent, dynamic and confident Tiger is depicted on this set of stamps (1st Local and $1.40).
